obligation.subject: obligated entities
obligation.action: file a suspicious transaction report (SOS/STR) to the UIF (Financial Intelligence Unit) without delay upon detection of suspicious activity
obligation.regulatory_penalty: Criminal referral and substantial administrative fine; suspension of the responsible officer's functions for wilful or systematic failure to report to the UIF

obligation.subject: credit institutions and intermediaries
obligation.action: immediately freeze funds and economic resources held by or for designated persons subject to the CTF freezing regime under D.Lgs 109/2007 and apply for de-listing or derogation where appropriate
obligation.regulatory_penalty: Criminal liability under D.Lgs 109/2007; administrative suspension of business activities and referral to judicial authority for breach of the freezing obligation

obligation.subject: obligated entities
obligation.action: apply enhanced due diligence measures to politically exposed persons, including senior management approval, enhanced source-of-wealth verification, and intensified ongoing monitoring
obligation.regulatory_penalty: Significant administrative sanction, public censure by the supervisory authority, and potential suspension of onboarding activities pending remediation

obligation.subject: obligated entities
obligation.action: conduct continuous monitoring and scrutiny of transactions throughout the business relationship to ensure consistency with the customer's risk profile and source of funds
obligation.regulatory_penalty: Suspension of business activities pending remediation and substantial periodic penalty payments for persistent failure to monitor transactions adequately

obligation.subject: obligated entities
obligation.action: verify the customer's identity through reliable, independent source documents, data, or information before establishing the business relationship or carrying out a transaction
obligation.regulatory_penalty: Administrative fine proportionate to the gravity of the breach and a supervisory corrective measure requiring remedial action within a fixed term

obligation.subject: obligated entities
obligation.action: determine the residual ML/TF risk level by combining the inherent risk score with the control-system vulnerability assessment on the prescribed 4x4 risk matrix and document the outcome
obligation.regulatory_penalty: Administrative sanction for inadequate risk governance and supervisory order to overhaul the risk-assessment methodology within a prescribed period

obligation.subject: payment service providers and intermediaries
obligation.action: include complete and accurate originator and beneficiary information on all funds transfers in accordance with the travel rule under Regulation EU 2023/1113 and D.Lgs 204/2024
obligation.regulatory_penalty: Substantial administrative fine and supervisory notice to cease non-compliant transfers; repeated breach may result in temporary licence restriction

obligation.subject: obligated entities
obligation.action: retain AML/KYC records, supporting documents, and transaction data for the statutory minimum retention period prescribed by applicable AML legislation
obligation.regulatory_penalty: Administrative fine and corrective order requiring restoration or reconstruction of missing records within a defined remediation timeline

obligation.subject: obligated entities
obligation.action: establish and maintain a dedicated AML compliance function with adequate organisational arrangements, clear reporting lines, and effective internal controls to prevent ML/TF risks
obligation.regulatory_penalty: Supervisory corrective measure and administrative sanction requiring appointment of a qualified MLRO and submission of a governance remediation plan within 90 days

obligation.subject: obligated entities
obligation.action: screen all customers, beneficial owners, and transactions against current UN and EU consolidated sanctions lists before onboarding and on an ongoing basis
obligation.regulatory_penalty: Criminal liability for knowingly facilitating prohibited transactions; licence suspension and referral to competent authorities for systemic failures in sanctions screening

obligation.subject: obligated entities
obligation.action: submit the aggregate AML statistical report (S.AR.A.) to the supervisory authority by the prescribed periodic deadline
obligation.regulatory_penalty: Written warning and requirement to submit the overdue report within a short grace period; minor administrative fine for repeated late submissions

obligation.subject: obligated entities
obligation.action: transmit UIF objective communications containing the required aggregate data on the schedule prescribed by the UIF
obligation.regulatory_penalty: Corrective measure and administrative notice to remedy the missed transmission; no criminal consequences for isolated scheduling failures

obligation.subject: obligated entities
obligation.action: provide periodic AML/CFT training to all relevant staff covering current typologies, red flags, and internal reporting procedures
obligation.regulatory_penalty: Administrative notice and corrective order to implement a compliant training programme; no immediate financial penalty for a first-time gap in training records

obligation.subject: obligated entities
obligation.action: maintain internal AML policies and procedures in documented, current form and ensure they reflect any changes to applicable legislation or supervisory guidance
obligation.regulatory_penalty: Written supervisory recommendation to update documentation; minor administrative sanction if deficiencies persist following a follow-up inspection

obligation.subject: obligated entities
obligation.action: format suspicious-activity report (SOS) fields in strict conformance with the Infostat-UIF technical specification for data quality and transmission
obligation.regulatory_penalty: Technical rejection of the report by the UIF system and a remediation notice requiring resubmission in the correct format; no standalone penalty for formatting defects alone

obligation.subject: obligated entities
obligation.action: file the routine quarterly compliance attestation with the supervisory authority by the prescribed deadline
obligation.regulatory_penalty: Reminder notice and minor administrative fee for late filing; remediated by submission within the correction window with no further consequence
